ProfilePhotoUploadRequest.title: ProfilePhotoUploadRequest
ProfilePhotoUploadRequest.description:
Request to finalize a profile photo upload after presigned upload to Cloudinary.

Flow:
1. Call GET /me/profile-photo/upload-url/ to get upload URL
2. Upload photo directly to Cloudinary using the presigned URL
3. Cloudinary returns public_id in the upload response
4. Call this endpoint with the photo_url and public_id from step 3
